description: The app's server, the server side of its web app: an API, scheduled jobs and a Postgres database Ploa runs on Google Cloud, either in Ploa's cloud (on Pro and Team, one for each app, its room set by the plan; nothing is bought) or in the person's own Google Cloud project (any plan, Google bills them). Says where it stands, its address, the live version and the last deploys, its variables (secrets by name only), its jobs, and what's needed when it's stopped. With no server, the kinds the workspace can have. Read-only. Start here.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
